needs_human.note: A new timing dependence in the Composer folder: when a submit finishes before the 400 ms debounce fires, the cleanup at Composer.tsx:158 cancels the preview, so selectedFolder stays empty and the next URL uses its own remembered folder. When the preview fires first, Composer.tsx:148 fills the picker with the remembered folder, the state is not reset after submit, and the next URL goes to that folder whatever its kind. The same user action can therefore send the next import to different folders. The picker shows the folder, so it is visible. Retaining the folder is old behaviour; a submit that also sends the right kind before the preview is what this change makes reliable.; Unchanged from r1 and still present: a failed resolve sends a channel URL to createLoft (Composer.tsx:153, 181), and tests encode it; a preview answering after a successful submit leaves the empty composer showing Subscribe (Composer.tsx:143-144); classified.current is keyed by URL only.
